email.subject1: a signal play for Tech9's partner ecosystem
email.body1:
Brennan, saw Tech9's partnership with Wingspan Studios giving founders capital plus a dedicated dev team, on top of another Inc. 5000 run.

Partner-sourced motions like that usually surface more co-sell targets than the team can personally work before the relationships cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously across the partner ecosystem, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Tech9's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brennan, quick follow-up for Tech9.

The Wingspan model creates a steady flow of co-sell intros, but most teams can't tell how many meetings the ecosystem actually needs to produce to hit number. So partner-sourced pipeline gets measured too late to course-correct.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a co-sell pilot playbook and our pipeline model, showing exactly where Tech9's partner coverage breaks if you only add people.
email.body3:
Brennan, last bit of proof for Tech9.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?
email.body4:
Brennan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Timing is everything, and standing up a venture-studio motion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a co-sell motion? I'll tailor it to Tech9 either way.
